                   BY ELECTRONIC FILING

                   Hon. Debbie-Anne A. Reese, Secretary
                   Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
                   888 First Street, NE
                   Washington, District of Columbia 20426


                          RE:     Request to Update Service Lists
                                  Docket No. EC26-131-000
                                  Docket No. EL26-63-000
                                  Docket No. EL26-67-000


                   Dear Secretary Reese:

                             Pursuant to 18 C.F.R. § 385.2010 of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission’s
                   Rules of Practice and Procedure, please add the following attorney to the official service
                   lists of the dockets identified above (and any associated sub-dockets), as additional counsel
                   for the Virginia Office of the Attorney General, Division of Consumer Counsel (“Virginia
                   Division of Consumer Counsel”):

                                  Marvi R. Ali
                                  Assistant Attorney General
                                  202 North Ninth Street
                                  Richmond, Virginia 23219
                                  mali@oag.state.va.us

                         Other counsel already appearing on behalf of the Virginia Division of Consumer
                   Counsel should remain as counsel on the service lists of the identified dockets.

                          Thank you for your assistance in this matter.
                                     Yours truly,
                                    /s/ John E. Farmer, Jr.
                                    John E. Farmer, Jr.
                                    Senior Assistant Attorney General
